Army Customisation allows you to further individualise your force. Archetypes change how you build your army by moving around units in the Army Organisation Plan (AOP) or letting you take more of a unit than you would normally be allowed to. Legacies give access to armories and disciplines of legendary factions. Traits enhance your units with special abilities that they normally would not be able to have.

You may select up to the following:
0-1 Archetype, 0-1 Legacy, 0-2 Traits

If a Trait is taken, all models / units in the army must be upgraded with it, unless stated otherwise.

- The army has access to units from Codex: Assassins.
- The army has access to units from Codex: Inquisition.
- Treat the Inquisition units as if "Ordo Hereticus" was selected as Legacy.

- Dominions can be taken as Troops.
- Only Dominion units count towards the 25% Troops limitation.
- All Dominion models must start the game as passengers inside a transport.

- Arco-flagellants and Repentia can be taken as Troops.
- For every 10 Arco-flagellant models, one unit of Penitent Engines can be taken as Troops.
- Battle Sisters and Sisters Novitiate become Elite choices.

- Celestian Squads can be taken as Troops.
- Battle Sisters and Sisters Novitiate become Elite choices.
- Arco-flagellants, Repentia and Penitent Engines can not be taken at all.
The army has access to equipment from the Order of the Valorous Heart in the Order Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Order of the Ebon Chalice in the Order Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Order of the Argent Shroud in the Order Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Order of Our Martyred Lady in the Order Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Order of the Bloody Rose in the Order Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Order of the Sacred Rose in the Order Armory.
The army gains access to a third trait and must select these traits: Raging Fervour, Rites of Fire and Unshakeable Vengeance. All traits combined cost 10 points for each non-character unit.
The army must select a second Legacy. Each model may only select items from one Legacy armory.
The unit may treat all of its "Rapid Fire" weapons during its Activation as "Assault" weapons (f.e. Rapid Fire 1 becomes Assault 1).
If the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, it gains +1 to melee hit rolls until the end of the current battle round.
The unit can re-roll one armor penetration or wound roll per activation.
If the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, it gains +1 Strength until the end of the current battle round.

Inferno pistols gain 1.5" range for their "Melta" rule, Meltas gain 3" range for their "Melta" rule and Multi-meltas gain 6" range for their "Melta" rule. (Note that this does NOT increase tha actual weapon's range)
Hand flamers gain 1.5" range, Flamers gain 3" range and Heavy flamers gain 6" range.
The unit can reroll one armor save per battle round.
If the unit is destroyed, it generates an additional Faith Point.
If the unit performs an Act of Faith, roll 1D6. On a 5+, the Faith Point is refunded.
The unit gains the "Deflagrate(5+)" ability with Bolt weapons.
The point costs for traits have to be paid per unit. If point costs are marked with *, then they must be paid for every Wound or Hull point in the unit.
